Subject: OrbitHealth — security onboarding: SIG initiation + gap analysis request

Hi Lisa / OrbitHealth team —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Quick recap and the security next steps we discussed so everything is in one place:

- Current ask: OrbitHealth to initiate a vendor security intake so our Security team can validate controls for production access. You mentioned procurement + security would coordinate.
- Immediate items we need from you: SOC 2 type II report or an expected audit completion date, confirmation on HIPAA / GDPR scope, and whether OrbitHealth requires a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) up front.
- For efficiency we'd like to kick off a SIG questionnaire (CAIQ/SIG standard). I attached a short prefill template (orbithealth-prefill-template.xlsx) to collect the small pieces we can provide ahead of the full CAIQ (it speeds review by ~3 days).
- Proposed timeline: Prefill returned in 5 business days → we submit CAIQ within 2 business days of that → evidence collection in parallel. If SOC 2 is needed, please share the report or a read-only link/CDN.

Can you confirm which SIG variant you prefer (SIG Lite vs full CAIQ) and whether procurement wants the mutual action plan formalized in DocuSign? I attached a short MUP draft (redwood-mup-20271116.docx) for reference.

Next steps (for OrbitHealth):
1) Confirm SIG variant + SOC2 availability (reply)
2) Return the prefill template with any fields you want us to complete (attachment)
3) Point-of-contact for technical evidence upload (S3/SharePoint/email)

Internal note: looping in Marissa to own the SOC 2 review and Ben to start the CAIQ prefill on our side (we can prefill vendor-facing answers to speed it up once we know which variant OrbitHealth wants).

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min follow-up if that helps.

— Avery

Thanks Avery — appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type II report from June 2027. I can provide a read-only link once you sign our vendor NDA (standard). Our security lead (me) will share the link to the report — ETA end of day Friday (11/19).
- HIPAA/GDPR: OrbitHealth processes limited PHI for a pilot in the US only; we will require HIPAA BA considerations. GDPR not in scope for this pilot.
- SIG variant: procurement prefers the SIG Lite first, then expand if needed. Can you confirm whether SIG Lite will be sufficient for production access in your view? If not, flag the specific areas that trigger full CAIQ.
- Evidence upload: we prefer a secure SharePoint link. Procurement will share a folder and upload instructions after the NDA is signed.

We will review the prefill and return with as many fields populated as possible. Also, procurement asked whether Redwood can provide a short checklist of the minimum evidence items required for a SIG Lite review (SOC 2 link, AUP/MFA screenshots, encryption info, incident response contact). That checklist would help our internal triage.

Thanks — Lisa
